name: License Client
description: Talks to the ansariaiwp license server: activate/validate/deactivate a license key, and delivers private plugin updates via the update_plugins filter (no wordpress.org, no GitHub links exposed to the site owner).
notes: license_key and license_status live inside the {{PREFIX}}_settings option but are written only by the guarded activate/validate/deactivate admin-post handlers (update_option directly). They are deliberately NOT exposed as editable Settings fields: a hand-edited status would bypass validation.
